senses.sense_definition: To make someone or something wealthy or more prosperous.

examples.text: The discovery of oil in the region will <w>enrich</w> the local community for generations.

target_lang_translations.ru: Открытие нефти в регионе будет <w>обогащать</w> местное сообщество на протяжении многих поколений.
target_lang_translations.zh: 该地区石油的发现将使当地社区世世代代变得<w>富裕</w>。

target_lang_translations.nl: De ontdekking van olie in de regio zal de lokale gemeenschap generaties lang <w>verrijken</w>.

target_lang_translations.de: Viele Menschen glauben, dass Reisen das Leben <w>bereichern</w> kann, indem es neue Perspektiven eröffnet.
target_lang_translations.fr: Beaucoup de gens croient que les voyages peuvent <w>enrichir</w> la vie en offrant de nouvelles perspectives.
target_lang_translations.it: Molte persone credono che viaggiare possa <w>arricchire</w> la vita offrendo nuove prospettive.

target_lang_translations.tr: Birçok insan, seyahat etmenin yeni bakış açıları sunarak hayatı <w>zenginleştirebileceğine</w> inanır.
target_lang_translations.es: Muchas personas creen que viajar puede <w>enriquecer</w> la vida al proporcionar nuevas perspectivas.
